case: Custom enum[] XML, HTML, and Markdown file-writer escaping
contract: The existing enum[] value contract supplies exact native type, array_to_json, array_send, SQL NULL element, empty label, literal NULL label, Unicode, quote, backslash, comma, markup, and formula-shaped label checks.
XML and HTML exports preserve PostgreSQL array text while escaping ampersands, angle brackets, quotes, and apostrophes.
Markdown export preserves markup as text and escapes backslashes; the value contract distinguishes literal NULL inside the array from its SQL NULL element through the native JSON oracle.
JSON, CSV, XLSX and SQL replay assertions remain in the same test, including native wire-byte equality and sibling-row preservation.
remaining: Other PostgreSQL array families and spreadsheet-application re-import combinations remain open; this case does not close the broader B3 engine, type, consumer, or configuration matrix.
